fix.text: 2% and 4% of the healing, last and ninth of ten.

review.verdict: Mind-controlled on Lucifron and beaten to death by the raid, which took your world buffs
review.summary: On Lucifron a Flamewaker Protector mind-controlled you, and at 0:17 Impending Doom, Necroshadow's Blade Flurry and Yulepunch's Bloodthirst finished you off: the only death of the kill, and all seven world buffs gone for the rest of MC. That's not on you. After it your parses ran under your usual on most bosses, though you still kicked one of the three Dark Mendings on Sulfuron and were fifth on Gehennas.

good.title: Dark Mending kicked
good.text: One of only three interrupts on Sulfuron's priests.

good.title: Gehennas 86
good.text: Fifth in raid damage, without world buffs.

good.title: Explosives
good.text: 5 Goblin Sapper Charges and 2 Dense Dynamite.

fix.title: Trash death
fix.text: A Lava Annihilator killed you at 29:35.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mongoose every pull, Giants and Greater Armor once, food on 7. After losing the world buffs, the elixirs were the thing you could still control.

50663.text: Mind-controlled, then killed by the raid. Not your fault.

review.verdict: Second in raid damage on Lucifron and Shazzrah in your second raid
review.summary: An 82 average and no deaths: second highest damage on Lucifron (91) and Shazzrah (86), fifth on Sulfuron and Majordomo (92). You even took a Lucifron's Curse off with a Restorative Potion. The weak spots are Ragnaros, where Lava Burst hit you for the second most damage in the raid, and Geddon.

good.title: Lucifron and Shazzrah
good.text: Second in raid damage on both.

good.title: Restorative Potion
good.text: Removed a Lucifron's Curse with it.

fix.title: Lava Burst
fix.text: 4,418 from Lava Burst, second most in the raid.

fix.title: Geddon
fix.text: 77, twelfth of fourteen warriors.

fix.title: Juju
fix.text: Juju Power once in ten pulls.

review.verdict: Top healer on Shazzrah, Sulfuron and Majordomo, and the best-prepared healer
review.summary: Your second raid with us and another strong one: first of the healers on Shazzrah (23%), Sulfuron (19%) and Majordomo (17%, only 18% overheal), second on Lucifron and Magmadar, with 3 Impending Dooms dispelled. Zanza, food and Distilled Wisdom on every pull, 4.3 buffs against 1.9 for the other healers.

good.title: Efficient
good.text: 18% overheal on Majordomo while doing the most healing.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: 4.3 consumable buffs a pull, the most of the healers, plus a Fire Protection Potion.

fix.title: Ragnaros and Garr
fix.text: Eighth of ten healers on both.

review.verdict: Tanked Majordomo to a 97, kicked a Dark Mending, and still no flask
review.summary: A 76 average against your usual 60, no deaths, and a 97 tanking Majordomo, the best tank parse of the raid. On Sulfuron you were one of only three people to interrupt a Dark Mending, on a night where Dark Mending healed the priests for 85k. Still no flask, and Ragnaros's Lava Burst found you four times.

good.title: Majordomo 97
good.text: Top tank of the raid on Majordomo, a personal best (90 before).

good.title: Dark Mending kicked
good.text: One of only three interrupts on Sulfuron's priests all fight.

fix.title: Lava Burst
fix.text: Four Lava Bursts for 4,392, tied for the most hits in the raid. Spread out from the people near you.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Giants, Mongoose, Greater Armor and Zanza on every pull, but no flask and no food: 4 buffs a pull against 5.6 for the other tanks. Two raids tonight without a flask.

50671.text: 97 tanking, top tank of the raid.

50672.text: Four Lava Burst hits, tied for the most.

review.verdict: Killed by Inferno, by Blast Wave and by a Firesworn
review.summary: On Geddon you took 7,269 from Inferno, the most in the raid, and were the only death of the kill at 0:24: your six world buffs were gone from there on. On Majordomo you were the first death at 0:11 (Shadow Shock and Blast Wave), and a Firesworn's Eruption killed you on trash. Your parses were last or second to last of the warriors on eight bosses. Garr 81 was a personal best and your consumables were good.

good.title: Garr 81
good.text: A personal best (55 before), eighth in raid damage.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: 5.4 buffs a pull against 3.9: Mongoose, Fortitude and more.

fix.title: Inferno
fix.text: 7,269 from Inferno, the most in the raid, and the only death of the kill at 0:24. Step out of melee while he channels it. It cost you six world buffs.

fix.title: Majordomo
fix.text: First death of the kill at 0:11: Shadow Shock (3,241) and Blast Wave (1,968).

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: A Firesworn's Eruption at 32:52.
